paper_title: Searching for Scalar Dark Matter via Coupling to Fundamental Constants with Photonic, Atomic and Mechanical Oscillators
notes: Paper constrains scalar DM coupling d_e (coupling to fine-structure constant alpha -> ScalarPhoton) and combination |d_me - d_g| via clock/oscillator comparisons (CSO, HM, quartz OCXO). Only the most-sensitive numeric value is given in text: d_e >~ 1.59e-1 over the band 4.4e-19 to 6.8e-14 eV. Full mass-dependent limit is in Fig. 3 (not numerically extractable here); the emitted two-point line uses the peak-sensitivity value across the stated band and is approximate. The |d_me-d_g| >~ 6.97e-1 limit is a separate combination not captured by a single enum type. DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed. 95% CL. Paper also includes projected future limits but the main result is a measured exclusion. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.55, 2))
